requirements.title: Proposed Service and Use
requirements.ask: Describe the proposed service, AI use case, and intended customer use and configuration.
requirements.reading: Northstar wants the description tied to its intended use and configuration.

requirements.title: Personal and Employee Data
requirements.ask: Explain the data used, whether personal information is processed and its categories, and the scope of employee data.
requirements.reading: Northstar specifically asks to clarify employee-data scope.

requirements.title: Storage and Inference Locations
requirements.ask: Describe storage locations and processing or inference locations separately, including inference geography.
requirements.reading: Northstar distinguishes storage location from processing and inference geography.

requirements.title: Retention by Data Type
requirements.ask: State the retention periods separately for source files, prompts, responses, logs and traces.
requirements.reading: Northstar wants retention clarified by data type.

requirements.title: Content-Accessing Subprocessors
requirements.ask: List the subprocessors that may access customer content.

requirements.title: Cross-Border Content Transfers
requirements.ask: Describe cross-border transfers of customer content.

requirements.title: Current Security Assurance
requirements.ask: Provide current SOC 2 or equivalent security assurance.

requirements.title: Penetration Test and Remediation
requirements.ask: Provide the latest external penetration-test report and remediation status; the predicted guidance also calls for a recent red-team or penetration-test report and cautions that evidence older than about six months may not work for a new customer.
requirements.reading: The roughly six-month recency caveat comes from predicted guidance, not an explicit customer requirement.

requirements.title: Encryption and Access Controls
requirements.ask: Describe encryption, identity and access management, and privileged production access controls.

requirements.title: Incident Response and Notification
requirements.ask: Describe the incident response process and customer notification approach.

requirements.title: Recovery Objectives and Evidence
requirements.ask: State the approved RTO and RPO and provide supporting evidence.

requirements.title: Models and Model Providers
requirements.ask: Identify the models and model providers used for this customer configuration.
requirements.reading: Northstar asks for the providers used in its own configuration.

requirements.title: Provider Content Retention and Training
requirements.ask: State whether model providers can retain or train on customer content.

requirements.title: Model Routing and Fallback
requirements.ask: Describe model routing and fallback for this customer.
requirements.reading: Northstar asks about its customer-specific routing and fallback.

requirements.title: Tool Authorization and Actions
requirements.ask: Explain tool authorization and controls, including whether the AI can call tools or APIs and take external actions.

requirements.title: AI Human Oversight Boundaries
requirements.ask: Describe human oversight and approval boundaries for AI actions.

requirements.title: Untrusted Content Controls
requirements.ask: Describe controls for prompt injection, untrusted documents and other untrusted content.

requirements.title: AI Evaluation and Limitations
requirements.ask: Describe the AI evaluation methodology and known limitations.

requirements.title: Provenance and Uncertainty Handling
requirements.ask: Describe how outputs handle provenance, citations and uncertainty.

requirements.title: DPA Technical Blockers
requirements.ask: Identify the technical facts blocking DPA completion.
requirements.reading: Northstar specifically asks for technical blockers to DPA completion.

requirements.title: Insurance Evidence and Expiry
requirements.ask: Provide insurance evidence and its expiry date.

requirements.title: Potential Approval Delays
requirements.ask: Identify information likely to delay approval.

requirements.title: External Submission Approval
requirements.ask: Identify which responses require human approval before external submission.
requirements.reading: Northstar asks about approval of externally submitted responses, separately from oversight of AI actions.

requirements.ask: Complete the Supplier review.

requirements.ask: Complete the Security review.

requirements.ask: Complete the Privacy review.

requirements.ask: Complete the Technology Resilience review.
